frozen_at_utc: 2026-10-05T07:02:04Z (written before any Upbit minute candle or Binance 1m kline of the test period was downloaded; only connectivity probes of a few KRW-AXS candles were made)
statement: Korean retail volume bursts on Upbit KRW markets lead Binance USDT-M perp prices on mid/small-cap coins at the 1-minute scale: trading the Binance perp in the direction of an Upbit burst minute, entered after that minute closes, is profitable after taker fees and liquidity-tier slippage.

universe.candidate_set: Every KRW-X market in Upbit /v1/market/all (snapshot 2026-10-05, 291 KRW markets) excluding stablecoins/fiat-pegged and gold tokens (USDT, USDC, USD1, USDE, USDS, USDG, RLUSD, PYUSD, EURC, JPYC, XAUT), whose Binance USDT-M perp (XUSDT, or 1000XUSDT / 1000000XUSDT / 1MXUSDT with price multiplier) has a monthly 1d kline file for 2025-03 on data.binance.vision.
universe.selection_rule_pre_train_only: Using ONLY 2025-03 daily data (before the train window): Upbit daily candles (KRW notional / mean KRW-USDT close of the day) and Binance perp 1d kline quote volume. Drop majors: Binance perp mean daily quote volume in 2025-03 > $300M. Require Binance perp mean daily quote volume >= $2M and Upbit mean daily USD notional >= $0.5M and Upbit KRW market present on all 31 days. Rank by ratio (Upbit USD notional / Binance perp quote volume, March 2025 sums) and keep the top 40. The resulting list is written to the addendum field 'coin_list' of this file before any minute data is downloaded.
universe.survivorship_note: The candidate set comes from Upbit's CURRENT market list; markets delisted from Upbit between 2025-03 and 2026-10 cannot be enumerated and are missing (survivorship bias, direction unknown, stated as a limitation).
universe.point_in_time_filter: At decision minute t, a coin is tradable only if (a) its trailing 7 complete UTC days (d-7..d-1) of Upbit USD notional / Binance perp quote volume >= 0.2 and (b) Binance perp trailing-7-day mean daily quote volume >= $1M (else excluded), both computed from the downloaded minute data of those days only.
universe.hl_mark: Each coin is marked HL-listed if its name (or k-prefixed name) appears in Hyperliquid info 'meta' on 2026-10-05 (current listing; informational, not point-in-time).

data.upbit: https://api.upbit.com/v1/candles/minutes/1?market=KRW-X&count=200&to=... (unauthenticated, 'to' exclusive, paginated backwards from 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z; <= 8 req/s). Minutes with no trades are absent -> notional 0, price carried forward. Same for KRW-USDT (KRW->USD conversion: USD notional = KRW notional / KRW-USDT close of the latest minute <= t).
data.binance: data.binance.vision futures/um monthly klines 1m (open/high/low/close/quote volume) and monthly fundingRate, months 2025-03 .. 2026-03 only.
data.holdout_protection: Nothing at or after 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z is requested from either source.
data.cache: data/raw/web/upbitlead/ (compact parquet, zips deleted after conversion), total < 600 MB; stop if disk free < 2.5 GB.

splits.train: decision minutes in [2025-04-01, 2026-01-01). History is available further back (KRW-AXS candles served for 2024-06), but the start is set to 2025-04-01 because Upbit pagination (200 minutes/request, <= 10 req/s shared IP) makes each extra month ~8,800 requests for 40 coins; this choice is made before any P&L.
splits.validation: [2026-01-01, 2026-04-01), examined ONCE, only for the single config chosen on train

signal.point_in_time: Upbit 1m candle for minute t (t..t+60s) is known only after it closes at t+60s. Features use candles <= t only.
signal.volume_z: L_t = ln(1 + USD notional_t); z_t = (L_t - mean(L_{t-1440..t-1})) / std(L_{t-1440..t-1}); requires the KRW market to have existed for the full prior 1440 minutes and std > 0.
signal.upbit_return_usd: r_t = (P_t / K_t) / (P_{t-1} / K_{t-1}) - 1, P = Upbit KRW close (carried forward), K = KRW-USDT close (carried forward).
signal.trigger: z_t >= Z AND |r_t| >= R AND USD notional_t >= $10,000. Direction = sign(r_t).
signal.no_gap_filter_in_grid: The lead doc's 'Binance has moved less than half' gap condition is reported as INFORMATIONAL on train only; it is not selectable.

execution.venue: Binance USDT-M perp taker (main). HL taker 4.5 bp reported as informational cost variant on HL-listed coins (still Binance prices).
execution.entry: Open of the Binance 1m bar starting at t+60s (the minute after the Upbit candle closes). A real order needs >= 2 s after the close to read the candle and send; the 1m open approximates a fill at t+60s+2s (stated approximation). Robustness: entry at the open of the following bar (t+120s, '+1 minute delay') reported for the chosen config on both splits.
execution.exit: Earliest of: TP at +2R from entry, SL at -R from entry (checked on 1m high/low of bars from entry bar onward; if both are touched in the same bar SL is assumed first; fill at the level, or at the bar open if the open is already beyond it), else time exit at the open of the bar H minutes after entry.
execution.position_rule: One position per coin; no new entry in a coin until its exit time. Positions in different coins may overlap. Unit notional per trade; P&L in bp of notional.

costs.taker_fee: 5 bp per side, Binance USDS-M regular user (https://www.binance.com/en/support/articles/360033544231, as cited in reports/hypotheses/datedbasis_preregistration.json). HL variant 4.5 bp (https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/trading/fees, tier 0).
costs.slippage_tier_rule: Per side, by Binance perp trailing-7-day mean daily quote volume (days d-7..d-1): >= $100M -> 10 bp; $30M-100M -> 15 bp; $10M-30M -> 20 bp; $1M-10M -> 25 bp; < $1M -> not traded. Applied to entry and exit fills (including TP/SL fills). Round trip 30-60 bp.
costs.funding: Binance funding rate charged if a funding timestamp falls in (entry, exit]: longs pay +rate, shorts receive it.
costs.sensitivity: slippage x2 reported for the chosen config (informational).

bar: per split: n >= 50 trades, net bp sum > 0, profit factor > 1.2, net bp sum without the 3 best trades > 0
selection: Event counts per config on train are reported before any P&L. Choose ONE config: among train configs meeting the full bar, the one with the highest train net bp sum. If none meets the bar on train, verdict FAIL and no validation P&L is computed. The chosen config is run on validation once. PASS only if it meets the bar on both train and validation.
informational_only: Reverse direction: Binance perp burst minutes (same z/R definitions on Binance quote volume and return) and the subsequent Upbit USD return at +1/+5/+30 min, signed by Binance direction (train only).
Response profile of Binance perp after Upbit bursts at +1/+5/+30 min, signed, gross (train).
Same-minute Binance return as a fraction of Upbit return on trigger minutes (who moved first within the minute).
Gap filter (Binance same-minute signed return < R/2) applied to the chosen config on train.
HL fee variant, slippage x2, +1 minute delay.
no_changes: No change to grid, costs, splits, exits or selection after this file is written. Any later deviation is listed as such in the report.
